finding.description:
Reentrancy in PrivateDeposit.CashOut(uint256) (source.sol#41-51):
	External calls:
	- msg.sender.call.value(_am)() (source.sol#45)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balances[msg.sender] -= _am (source.sol#47)
	PrivateDeposit.balances (source.sol#5) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- PrivateDeposit.CashOut(uint256) (source.sol#41-51)
	- PrivateDeposit.Deposit() (source.sol#30-39)
	- PrivateDeposit.balances (source.sol#5)
